ventajas.texto: They join with a room code and a nickname. No emails, no real names, no consent forms to manage. It is the difference a school notices when reviewing privacy.
Save your quizzes and bring them back next year. Five question types, with per-question weighting and images.
When the lesson ends you get the report: which questions the class got wrong, worst first, and how each student did.
Tested with 200 players answering at once without losing a single score. If someone reloads the page, they come back where they were.
